desc.en: A collection of Food Rabbit fur, spun into yarn. Crafted by hand, this carefully spun yarn is used in making many traditional garments and rugs.
desc.ja: 食料ウサギの毛を集め、紡績したもの。ひとつひとつ手作業で、丁寧かつ丹念に紡がれたこの糸は伝統的な洋服や絨毯を作るのに使われている

desc.en: Effect: Increases sell price at shops by a small amount.
desc.ja: 効果：お店の買取価格が少し上がる

desc.en: Effect: Raises item's effect by equipment frames x 2％.
desc.ja: 効果：装備枠の大きさ×２％アイテムの効果が上昇する

desc.en: Increases the power of the item by a small amount, as well as the wait time after using it.
desc.ja: アイテムを使った後の待ち時間が少し延びる代わりに、威力も少し上昇する
